data.title: 夏洛特 · 晨曦床单的娇羞初醒
data.description: 清晨的柔和光线穿过白色纱帘照在凌乱的被褥上。夏洛特侧躺在枕头边，娇小的身躯裹在宽大的纯白羽绒被中，只露出圆润白皙的香肩与粉嫩的锁骨。浅金色发丝散乱在枕套上，她拉起被角遮住半张通红的脸颊，碧蓝眼眸清澈微漾，轻声吐露着清晨的动人问候。
data.location: sunlit bedroom with rumpled white linen sheets
data.action: lying on side in bed, pulling white sheet up to nose, bare shoulder exposed, blonde hair messy on pillow, blushing ears and cheeks, blue eyes gleaming with morning affection
data.lighting: soft diffused morning sunbeam casting delicate highlights on white linen
data.mood: pure blushing vulnerability, sweet domestic morning bliss
data.promptProse: Peeking over a white bedsheet in soft morning sunlight, Charlotte lies with her bare shoulders exposed amidst messy pillows. Her blue eyes shine with sweet embarrassment and genuine morning happiness.
data.animaCaption: Charlotte peeking out from under white bedsheets in the morning, blushing adorably.
